IS 19059 : 2024 Continuously Transposed Conductor (CTC) Copper Winding Wires
ICS 29.060.10
ICS 29.060.10
ETD 33
ETD 33
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard specifies the requirement of the continuously transposed conductors with type, product variety structure, technical requirements, acceptance rules and packaging marking.
1.2 Continuously transposed conductors are generally used in the electrical windings of a variety of transformers including oil-immersed, dry-type, and reactors etc.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards.
